### [`client-messages.ts`](../../i18n/client-messages.ts)

- `pickMessages` _function_: Narrows a message tree to the given namespaces, preserving key paths so `useTranslations('seo.faq')` and friends keep resolving unchanged.
- `mergeMessages` _function_: Merges a delta onto a base message tree, returning a new object.
